run_diatomic_curve_cli: run the diatomic tests CLI to compute potential energy curves for molecules or materials using a pretrained MLIP model
compute_diatomic_curve: compute a diatomic potential energy curve by predicting energies across 100 interatomic distances using a pretrained predictor
get_model: load a pretrained machine learning interatomic potential model from a name or path for energy prediction on CUDA
generate_plot: generate a matplotlib plot of a diatomic potential energy curve and save it as a high-resolution PNG image
combined_plot: generate a combined matplotlib plot overlaying multiple diatomic potential energy curves and save as a PNG image
